process_type: WaterTAP BSM2 full water resource recovery facility with primary clarification, activated sludge, secondary clarification, thickening, anaerobic digestion, dewatering, and liquid recycles
source_basis: Source flowchart evidence unavailable: no --source-flowchart was provided.
WaterTAP BSM2 documentation displays BSM2.png as the official full wastewater treatment plant process flow diagram.

The official model builds primary and secondary clarification, five activated sludge reactors, thickener, anaerobic digester, dewatering unit, ASM/ADM translators, pressure changer, products, and recycle loops.
The default simulation is steady-state and fully specified before costing and optimization hooks are added.

units.role: mixes primary feed and thickener recycle
mixes primary effluent and return activated sludge
mixes secondary sludge and reactor underflow
anaerobic digester producing liquid digestate and biogas

arcs.role: mixed influent to second primary mixer

translator_constraints: asm_adm maps ASM1 sludge state to ADM1 anaerobic digestion state
adm_asm maps ADM1 liquid digestate back to ASM1 state for dewatering

initialization.strategy: WaterTAP BSM2 build, set_operating_conditions, initialize_system, scale_system, scaled steady-state solve

notes_for_agent_a: Use the WaterTAP BSM2 full flowsheet PFD as source evidence; preserve liquid recycle loops and the ASM1/ADM1 translator boundary.
